description: For any propositional theory \(\Gamma\) and formula \(C\), \(\Gamma\models C\) if and only if some finite \(\Delta\subseteq\Gamma\) satisfies \(\Delta\models C\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.finite_semantic_support.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.Theory α)
  (C : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.TheoryEntails Γ C ↔
    ∃ Δ, ↑Δ ⊆ Γ ∧ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Entails Δ C
